business_summary: Nippon Signal Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops technologies for railway signal systems in Japan. The company operates in two segments, Transportation Infrastructure Business and ICT Solution Business segments. It offers railway signal safety systems, road traffic safety systems, station service automation systems, security solutions, parking lot system, robotics, platform safety systems, ground penetrating radars, and 3D laser ranging image sensors and MEMS scanners. The company is also involved in manufacture, sale, and maintenance of railway signaling equipment and road traffic safety systems; and manufacturing, sale, and maintenance services of automatic flood control equipment and parking equipment. Nippon Signal Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1928 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
